title: First Communion Girls in Centerline, 1930s B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
First Communion - Centerline
Gert, Connie, Aggie & Pat
description: A 1930s black and white snapshot depicting four young girls—Gert, Connie, Aggie, and Pat—gathered outside a brick home in Center Line, Michigan, dressed in white attire for a Catholic First Communion celebration.
